title: Fix Compose Coda Desktop Startup
description: Investigate and fix Compose Coda Desktop local startup. The attempted command `uv nx dev @semio-tech/coda-desktop` is invalid because `uv` has no `nx` subcommand, and the supported Nx launch path currently fails due to duplicate inferred `.coda` project names under coda/examples. Repair the workspace so `npx nx dev @semio-tech/coda-desktop` starts successfully, update launch/docs wiring if needed, validate with runtime output, and close the ticket with the changed files.
summary: Fixed Compose Coda Desktop startup by repairing the sidecar launch argument constant in the Electron main process and assigning unique Nx-visible project names to the example .coda manifests so `npx nx dev @semio-tech/coda-desktop` resolves and launches successfully. Validated with `npx nx show project @semio-tech/coda-desktop` and a runtime `NODE_OPTIONS= npx nx dev @semio-tech/coda-desktop --verbose` run that reached Electron Forge, built Vite bundles, and launched the Electron app.
